one_line: chemical property space of wakefulness, ADHD and weight-loss drugs
data: PubChem (PUG REST molecular properties, one row per compound)
hand-assigned use classes for twenty-four wakefulness, ADHD, narcolepsy and weight-loss compounds

decisions.chose: sampling compounds by what they are licensed for
decisions.because: the question is whether use classes hold up against chemistry, so drawing the sample by structure would presuppose the answer
decisions.evidence: A scaffold-based sample would have assumed the answer.

decisions.chose: percentile rank within the set for the radar spokes
decisions.because: one peptide is twenty times the mass of everything else, so min-max compressed every small molecule onto the same point
decisions.evidence: raw min-max scaling was the first version and every small molecule came out as the same dot

decisions.over: a UMAP embedding of Morgan fingerprints
decisions.because: both axes are interpretable without a legend and a reader can check them, where an embedding only looks impressive
decisions.evidence: would tell a reader nothing they could check

decisions.chose: keeping semaglutide on a log mass axis
decisions.because: the span from a small amine to a peptide inside one licensed class is the central observation
decisions.evidence: Excluding it would hide the single largest fact in the dataset

decisions.chose: keeping withdrawn drugs such as sibutramine and phenylpropanolamine in the set
decisions.over: restricting it to currently marketed drugs
decisions.because: keeping only the survivors removes the contrast that makes survivorship interesting
decisions.evidence: the question of what distinguishes a survivor is part of the point

broke.what: enantiomer pairs (dexmethylphenidate/methylphenidate, armodafinil/modafinil, amphetamine/dextroamphetamine) return identical 2D descriptors from PubChem and land on exactly the same point, so they were merged into one labelled marker and the real clinical difference between them stays invisible in this view
broke.evidence: That is a limitation of the descriptors, not a property of the drugs

question: Do the classes medicine files wakefulness, ADHD and weight-loss drugs under survive contact with the molecules themselves?
rejected_line: Scaled the radar spokes with min-max first; every small molecule collapsed to the same dot next to the peptide, so switched to percentile rank within the set.
